locations.note: On the night of the 2013 outbreak, Joel flees the Austin suburbs with his brother Tommy and his daughter Sarah, who is shot by a soldier and dies in his arms.

Twenty years on, the smuggler Joel and his partner Tess are hired by the Fireflies' Marlene to get Ellie out of the Boston quarantine zone; the Left Behind chapter returns to the city for Ellie's night in an abandoned mall with her friend Riley.
Joel and Tess bring Ellie to the State House to hand her to the Fireflies and find them dead; Tess, bitten on the way, stays behind to hold off the soldiers.
Joel and Ellie get a working vehicle with the help of Bill, a smuggler and survivalist living alone in Lincoln.
Bandits wreck Joel and Ellie's truck in Pittsburgh; they escape the city with the brothers Henry and Sam, until Sam turns and Henry shoots him and then himself.

In the fall Joel finds his brother Tommy running a fortified settlement by a hydroelectric dam near Jackson; at the end Joel and Ellie head back here, and on the way he lies to her about the Fireflies.
Joel and Ellie ride to the University of Eastern Colorado looking for the Fireflies, find the campus abandoned, and Joel is badly wounded there.

Through the winter at the Lakeside Resort in the mountains, Ellie keeps the wounded Joel alive, is captured by David's cannibal survivors, and kills David in a burning restaurant. In Left Behind, Ellie searches an abandoned mall nearby for the medicine that saves Joel.
In spring the Fireflies take Ellie to their hospital in Salt Lake City to remove the infected part of her brain; Joel kills the surgeon, carries her out and shoots Marlene in the garage.

routes.name: Joel and Ellie
routes.note: From the outbreak in Austin and the Boston quarantine zone across the country through Pittsburgh, Jackson and a Colorado winter to the Fireflies' hospital in Salt Lake City, and back to Jackson.
